thread:
Maria C: quick handoff for night shift — short summary of what happened and what stayed open
Maria C: ~22:14 we started seeing embedding p95 jump in eu-west while throughput stayed steady. oncall-bot paged at 22:16 (page id 31245)
oncall-bot: [ALERT] embedding-service p95 > 3s in eu-west — paging primary
Maria C: immediate mitigation: routed new embedding requests for eu-west to the dedicated pool in us-east (temporary), and disabled cross-region fallback for embeddings to avoid extra cold loads. that brought p95 back under 800ms by 22:28
Lucy H: thanks — did we identify a root cause or just mitigations?
Maria C: initial theory: model load latency on a subset of eu-west hosts after an infra node kernel update. noticed high disk latency on two machines, model load times spiked in logs. snippet: ```
[22:12:47] model_load: /models/embed-v2 -> 4.1s
[22:13:02] model_load: /models/embed-v2 -> 4.7s
[22:15:10] dispatch: queue_wait 0.01s
```
Sanjay P: I saw the same on host-32 & host-41 — I temporarily cordoned host-41 out of the pool at 22:22, and warm-cache prefetch was triggered for the remaining hosts
Dan R: what exactly did we change in routing? want the runbook step for oncoming shift
Maria C: routing changes: set routing policy for embeddings: prefer-dedicated(us-east) for new requests, set failover to local eu-west only after 5s. rollback later if stable. runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/EMBED-Runbook (see section "regional fallback")
Lucy H: noting primary/secondary for the night — primary = Lucy H (00:00-08:00 UTC), secondary = Sanjay P (backup for 00:00-04:00, then Dan R covers 04:00-08:00). Maria: handing off as outgoing primary for 22:00-00:00
Maria C: confirmed. current status: embeddings stable, p95 eu-west ~720ms, no customer-facing error pages observed. external dashboards updated: https://console.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/latency
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-06-08-embeds-euw — status: mitigated (routing quarantine)
Sanjay P: outstanding actions for morning: 1) infra to inspect host-32 & host-41 disk I/O metrics (I raised infra ticket INF-789) 2) add a prewarm job to the autoscaler to ensure model tarballs are cached after deploys 3) add a temporary alert tweak so p95 baseline above 1s doesn't immediate-page (we paged at 3s but had noisy spikes)
Dan R: coverage gap note: between 03:00-05:00 UTC Dan is primary but secondary is unassigned due to a PTO overlap. recommend we publish a call-for-volunteers in #eng-oncall now or escalate to on-call roster to fill 03:00-05:00
Lucy H: I'll DM ops and see if someone can swap. also logging this as "post-incident follow-up" with owner tag: Sanjay
Maria C: follow-ups I left in the incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/EMBED-31245 — includes logs, host IDs, and commands used. quick commands used during mitigation for reference: ```
# cordon host
rbctl host cordon host-41 --reason "high disk latency"
# reroute embeddings
rbctl route set embeddings --prefer dedicated:us-east --fail_after 5s
# trigger warm cache
rbctl model prewarm embed-v2 --region eu-west
```
Lucy H: any customer impact to call out? I checked support queue — one customer reported slower search in EU but no dropped requests. support ticket 8421 opened, assigned to Lucy
Maria C: confirmed, no broad customer impact. next steps for incoming shift: - monitor p95 for next 3 hours - confirm infra fixes host I/O - roll back cross-region route after infra signoff - fill 03:00-05:00 secondary or adjust paging policy
Sanjay P: I'll own infra follow-up and post a remediation summary in the ticket. planning a short healthcheck cron at 23:30 to ensure model loads stay <1s for 10 consecutive samples
Lucy H: copying runbook pointers into my personal checklist. if anything degrades, page primary as usual. thumbs up if you read this: :thumbsup:
Dan R: :thumbsup: I'll try to cover the early gap but will ping if not possible in 30m
Maria C: handing off to Lucy now. thanks team — keeping the channel open until the early morning handoff.
